name: Paqy
message: 「Tending to your vegetable garden first thing on a Sunday morning?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got time before we're supposed to meet up.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Haa, you sure are diligent.」

name: Sasami
message: 「Bawk, cluck-cluck-cluck, bwaaawk.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mornin', Sasamiii.」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cluck-cluck, bawk, bawk.」
Huh? That's Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry. Keep it down today. If Synn notices me, my plan is ruined--hey! That tickles!」

name: Sasami
message: 「Bawk, bawk, cock-a-doodle-doo.」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Egh.」
Tossing Sasami some earthworms I'd set aside while gardening,

name: Synn
message: 「What's up, though? We were supposed to meet in front of the station at 10, right?」
It's 7 AM right now. Three hours to go.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, you brought soba too... Thanks, as always.」
Even though we're going on a date today, she really didn't have to go that far.

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why are you awake at this hour?! Doing yard work, no less!」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean 'this hour'? It's the same time as usual.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even earlier than usual, actually.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why would you wake up early?! Even after I told you yesterday I'd wake you up if you overslept!」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't oversleep. The early bird catches the worm.」

name: Paqy
message: 「To begin with, there's no way Synn-sama, who never stays up late, would oversleep.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Well, that's true, I guess.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But still! D-Don't you ever wish I'd wake you up or anything? Having your childhood friend wake you up is a guy's dream, isn't it?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. That seems kind of sloppy, though. It's uncool. You should at least wake up on your own.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...So much for my sweet, embarrassing plan to stare at Synn's sleeping face to my heart's content and wake him up with a morning kiss...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Soba. Synn-sama's just that kind of guy, so you gotta be blunt and say something like, 'I'm coming to wake you up, so stay asleep until then'」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that how it is?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No way! L-L-Like I'd ever make a stupid request like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy. Don't say weird things.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Same as ever, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, um... today's our first date, right? Maybe that's why I woke up early.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「D-Date?! W-Well, we are taking the train to see a movie, and doing a l-little shopping.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then maybe getting something to eat, and then, and then, uwaaaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, was I wrong? I totally thought that's what it was, so I was looking forward to--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're not wrong, you're not wrong, you're not wrong! Y-Yeah, a date, a date! Mhm. That's right!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A date, huh... ufufu. Ahahahahaha. Ufufufu. Ehe. Ehe♪ Ehehehehehehe.」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious! Man, this is good!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You always say it's delicious, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because it is! Being able to eat food this good makes me so happy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Is that so. Ahahahahahaha.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, I'm still no match for my old man, though!」
Apparently, my dad and Nanaka's old man fought side by side during the previous Re-Crea.
And back then, the woman her old man fell in love with at first sight was Nanaka's mom.
They say her old man mastered making soba just to win the approval of Nanaka's grandpa, who stood in the way of their romance.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Soba. You've been here practically every day lately.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-That's not true! It's not every day!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm happy I get to eat this soba five days a week, but... having you take care of me this much makes me feel a little bad.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm actually holding back here, ya know!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why don't you just move in here already? Then you'd have Synn-sama all to yourself, body and soul. Literally down to what goes into his stomach!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-what the heck are you sayin'!」

name: Paqy
message: 「While you're at it, I'd appreciate it if you looked after Synn-sama's wallet too. It'd really improve my standard of living.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-how could I do something as shameless as barging in like an uninvited wife!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-wife?! Th-that's still way too soon!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-right! I mean, it's basically officially recognized already, though. B-but, um, well!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama could always move into your place instead.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-yeah, right! A-anyway, I even prepared dessert today!」
The now-familiar eclairs were served to me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm actually pretty confident about this batch!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」
Two months had passed since Nanaka first made eclairs for me.
She had been feeding them to me at a pace of one per week.

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the food!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ba-dump, ba-dump. H-hey, how is it?」
Why?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Agh. I get it. Don't say it. Don't say a word!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「One of these days, I'm gonna make Synn pull that same face again!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-well then, I'll be waiting at the station at ten!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, why? Let's just go together.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you know, um, our meetup spot was supposed to be in front of the station at ten, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wanna make it feel like a proper date, ya know.」

name: Synn
message: 「We finally get to spend a long time together, so that'd be a waste.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I give up! Synn. I can't beat you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Beat me at what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Never mind that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey. Synn. My eyes aren't turning red, are they?」
Because Nanaka leans in as if peering closely at my face,
just that alone makes my cheeks feel a little warm.

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」
Ever since then, Nanaka's eyes have taken on just a tiny hint of red compared to before, though it's faint enough that probably only I can tell.
According to Melilot-san, it stabilized because Nanaka accepted being half-demon.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright.」
Apparently, if you stay in the Human World for a long time, even demons stop manifesting their traits.
It seems their magic degrades and fades, leaving them practically human.
Though, the fact that demon traits manifested in Nanaka--a half-demon--in the first place was something that normally wouldn't happen.

name: Synn
message: 「They haven't glowed since then, right?」
That only happened because of Soltia's sorcery planted in Nanaka's room.
It was a very weak spell, one whose effects only reached inside Nanaka's room.
That's why it wasn't discovered until Melilot-san investigated.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just in case! Today's special, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It is our first date, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why'd you have to make me self-conscious all of a sudden, geez!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Anyway, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um, you know. Do you think Sengen'in-sensei made up that assignment just so she could get into my room?」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Probably, yeah?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...She really was a weird person.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, she was.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why do you think they tried to destroy this world?」
The reason Bylous and Soltia sought Re-Crea remains unknown.

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if Azel would know?」
Azel, who has been sleeping in a room at the Kujou mansion ever since the Holy Night Festival.
According to Melilot-san, the day she wakes up isn't far off.

name: Synn
message: 「Even if she does know, though, I wonder if she'll tell us...?」
Apparently, even when Azel wakes, most of her original angelic power will have vanished along with Re-Crea's power, leaving her unable to return to Heaven.
Helena-san said she intends to accept Azel back as a student once she wakes up.

name: Nanaka
message: 「This time we can become proper friends. Then she'll tell us.」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope so.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It'll be fine! Right now, I feel like anything I do is gonna go great!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...H-Hey, Synn.」
I knew what Nanaka wanted to say.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehehe.」
Nanaka holds her hand out to me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong? Did you forget something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that's not it. Synn, you're making that face from back then.」

name: Synn
message: 「Back then?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Way back when, the face you made when you ate that eclair.」
Ah, I see.

name: Synn
message: 「Of course I am.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Really?」

name: Synn
message: 「...I mean, just being like this with you makes me super happy, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Idiot... Don't just say stuff like that so casually!」
Nanaka leaned in even closer to me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's embarrassing, you know... Even if it makes me happy.」
My heart is pounding like crazy too.
We haven't even reached the station yet, and my heart is already racing this much.
Will my heart even last until the end of the date?

name: Synn
message: 「Um, s-so that eclair was 99 points, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then since you make me happier than that eclair does, Nanaka, that makes you a hundred out of a hundred.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Of course I am!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm your girlfriend, after all, Synn! I wouldn't accept anything less than a hundred!」
Still, if we're already at a hundred right now
I thought to myself that we're surely going to become happier than any score could ever measure.
